code_block:
name: 🔐 Secret & Credential Scanning
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: source-control-validation
    if: always()
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Create Reports Directory
        run: mkdir -p ${{ env.REPORTS_DIR }}

      # ── Gitleaks ────────────────────────────────────────
      # FIX: gitleaks-action@v2 does NOT accept 'args' input.
      # It automatically runs detect + uploads results.sarif.
      # Output path is fixed to results.sarif by the action.
      - name: Run Gitleaks
        id: gitleaks
        uses: gitleaks/gitleaks-action@v2
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          # GITLEAKS_LICENSE not required for personal/public repos
        continue-on-error: true

      # Copy the SARIF produced by the action to our reports dir
      - name: Copy Gitleaks SARIF to Reports
        if: always()
        run: |
          [ -f results.sarif ] \
            && cp results.sarif ${{ env.REPORTS_DIR }}/gitleaks.sarif \
            || echo '{"version":"2.1.0","runs":[]}' > ${{ env.REPORTS_DIR }}/gitleaks.sarif
          # Also produce a JSON summary for the dashboard
          echo '{"tool":"gitleaks","status":"${{ steps.gitleaks.outcome }}","findings":[]}' \
            > ${{ env.REPORTS_DIR }}/gitleaks.json

      - name: Upload Gitleaks SARIF to GitHub Security
        uses: github/codeql-action/upload-sarif@v3
        if: always()
        with:
          sarif_file: ${{ env.REPORTS_DIR }}/gitleaks.sarif
          category: gitleaks
        continue-on-error: true

      # ── TruffleHog ──────────────────────────────────────
      - name: Run TruffleHog
        id: trufflehog
        uses: trufflesecurity/trufflehog@main
        with:
          path: ./
          base: ${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}
          head: HEAD
          extra_args: --only-verified
        continue-on-error: true

      - name: Save TruffleHog Result
        if: always()
        run: |
          echo '{"tool":"trufflehog","status":"${{ steps.trufflehog.outcome }}","findings":[]}' \
            > ${{ env.REPORTS_DIR }}/trufflehog.json

      # ── Upload combined secret scan artifact ─────────────
      - name: Upload Secret Scan Reports
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: secret-scan-reports
          path: ${{ env.REPORTS_DIR }}/
          overwrite: true

      # ── Live dashboard update ────────────────────────────
      - name: Update Dashboard
        if: always()
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}

      - name: Push Stage Status to Dashboard
        if: always()
        env:
          STAGE_NAME: "secret-detection"
          STAGE_LABEL: "Secret Detection"
          STAGE_ICON: "🔐"
          JOB_STATUS: ${{ job.status }}
          RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
          COMMIT: ${{ github.sha }}
          BRANCH: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          ACTOR: ${{ github.actor }}
        run: python3 .github/scripts/update-dashboard.py
        continue-on-error: true

      - name: Deploy Partial Dashboard
        if: always()
        uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v4
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          publish_dir: ${{ env.DASHBOARD_DIR }}
          keep_files: false
          commit_message: "dashboard: secret-detection=${{ job.status }} [run ${{ github.run_id }}]"
        continue-on-error: true

name: 🔒 Salesforce Org Security
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [sast-salesforce-scanner]
    if: always()

    permissions:
      contents: write
      pages: write
      id-token: write

    steps:

        uses: actions/checkout@v4

        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"
        continue-on-error: true

      # -----------------------------------------------------
      # Setup Node.js
      # -----------------------------------------------------
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
        continue-on-error: true

      # -----------------------------------------------------
      # Setup Java
      # -----------------------------------------------------
      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 17
        continue-on-error: true

      # -----------------------------------------------------
      # Install Salesforce CLI
      # -----------------------------------------------------
      - name: Install Salesforce CLI
        run: |
          npm install --global @salesforce/cli || true
          sf --version || true
        continue-on-error: true

      # -----------------------------------------------------
      # Install Salesforce Plugins
      # -----------------------------------------------------
      - name: Install Salesforce Plugins
        run: |
          sf plugins install @salesforce/plugin-health-check || true
        continue-on-error: true

      # -----------------------------------------------------
      # Verify Salesforce CLI
      # -----------------------------------------------------
      - name: Verify Salesforce CLI
        run: |
          sf --version || true
          sf plugins || true
        continue-on-error: true

      # -----------------------------------------------------
      # Authenticate Salesforce Org
      # -----------------------------------------------------
      - name: Authenticate Salesforce Org
        env:
          SF_AUTH_URL: ${{ secrets.SF_AUTH_URL }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "$SF_AUTH_URL" ]; then
            echo "SF_AUTH_URL not configured"
            exit 0
          fi

          echo "$SF_AUTH_URL" | sf org login sfdx-url --stdin \
            --alias security-scan \
            --set-default || true

          sf org list || true
        continue-on-error: true

      # -----------------------------------------------------
      # Verify Salesforce Org Access
      # -----------------------------------------------------
      - name: Verify Salesforce Org Access
        run: |
          sf org display --target-org security-scan || true
        continue-on-error: true

      # -----------------------------------------------------
      # Run Salesforce Health Check
      # -----------------------------------------------------
      - name: Run Salesforce Health Check
        run: |
          sf org health-check \
            --target-org security-scan \
            --json \
            > reports/health-check.json 2>/dev/null || \
          echo '{"status":"skipped"}' > reports/health-check.json
        continue-on-error: true

      # -----------------------------------------------------
      # Assess Guest User Exposure
      # -----------------------------------------------------
      - name: Assess Guest User Exposure
        run: |
          sf data query \
            --query "SELECT Id, Name, ProfileId, IsActive FROM User WHERE UserType='Guest'" \
            --target-org security-scan \
            --json \
            > reports/guest-users.json 2>/dev/null || \
          echo '{"status":"skipped"}' > reports/guest-users.json
        continue-on-error: true

      # -----------------------------------------------------
      # Assess Elevated Profiles
      # -----------------------------------------------------
      - name: Assess Elevated Profiles
        run: |
          sf data query \
            --query "SELECT Id, Name, PermissionsModifyAllData, PermissionsViewAllData FROM Profile WHERE PermissionsModifyAllData = true OR PermissionsViewAllData = true" \
            --target-org security-scan \
            --json \
            > reports/elevated-profiles.json 2>/dev/null || \
          echo '{"status":"skipped"}' > reports/elevated-profiles.json
        continue-on-error: true

            --target "force-app/**/*.cls" \
            --format json \
            --outfile reports/org-security-scan.json || \
          echo '{"status":"skipped"}' > reports/org-security-scan.json
        continue-on-error: true

      # -----------------------------------------------------
      # Validate Reports
      # -----------------------------------------------------

          ls -la reports || true
        continue-on-error: true

      # -----------------------------------------------------

        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: org-security-reports
          path: reports/*.json
          overwrite: true
        continue-on-error: true

runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      # -------------------------
      # Install Dependencies
      # -------------------------
      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 17

      - name: Install Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 18

      - name: Install Salesforce CLI
        run: npm install -g @salesforce/cli

      # -------------------------
      # Install Security Tools
      # -------------------------
      - name: Install PMD
        run: |
          wget https://github.com/pmd/pmd/releases/download/pmd_releases/7.0.0/pmd-dist-7.0.0-bin.zip
          unzip pmd-dist-7.0.0-bin.zip

      - name: Install Gitleaks
        run: sudo apt install gitleaks -y

      - name: Install TruffleHog
        run: |
          curl -LO https://github.com/trufflesecurity/trufflehog/releases/download/v3.95.2/trufflehog_3.95.2_linux_amd64.tar.gz
          tar -xzf trufflehog_3.95.2_linux_amd64.tar.gz
          sudo mv trufflehog /usr/local/bin/

      - name: Install jq
        run: sudo apt install jq -y

      # -------------------------
      # Run Scans
      # -------------------------
      - name: Run Gitleaks
        run: gitleaks detect --source . --report-format json --report-path dashboard/gitleaks.json || true

      - name: Run PMD
        run: |
          ./pmd-bin-7.0.0/bin/pmd check \
          --dir force-app \
          --rulesets category/apex/security.xml \
          --format json \
          --report-file dashboard/pmd.json || true

      - name: Run TruffleHog
        run: trufflehog filesystem . --json > dashboard/trufflehog.json || true

      # -------------------------
      # Convert PMD → Sonar format
      # -------------------------

        run: bash convert-pmd-to-sonar.sh

      # -------------------------
      # SonarQube Scan
      # -------------------------
      - name: Sonar Scan
        uses: sonarsource/sonarqube-scan-action@v2
        env:
          SONAR_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SONAR_TOKEN }}
          SONAR_HOST_URL: ${{ secrets.SONAR_HOST_URL }}

      - name: Quality Gate
        uses: sonarsource/sonarqube-quality-gate-action@v1
        timeout-minutes: 5
        env:
          SONAR_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SONAR_TOKEN }}

      # -------------------------
      # Update Dashboard JSON
      # -------------------------
      - name: Update Dashboard
        run: bash update-dashboard.sh

      # -------------------------
      # Upload dashboard artifact
      # -------------------------
      - name: Upload Dashboard
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dashboard
          path: |
            dashboard/index.html
            dashboard/dashboard-data.json

      # -------------------------
      # Install Dependencies
      # -------------------------
      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 17

      - name: Install Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 18

      - name: Install Salesforce CLI
        run: npm install -g @salesforce/cli

      # -------------------------
      # Install Security Tools
      # -------------------------
      - name: Install PMD
        run: |
          wget https://github.com/pmd/pmd/releases/download/pmd_releases/7.0.0/pmd-dist-7.0.0-bin.zip
          unzip pmd-dist-7.0.0-bin.zip

      - name: Install Gitleaks
        run: sudo apt install gitleaks -y

      - name: Install TruffleHog
        run: |
          curl -LO https://github.com/trufflesecurity/trufflehog/releases/download/v3.95.2/trufflehog_3.95.2_linux_amd64.tar.gz
          tar -xzf trufflehog_3.95.2_linux_amd64.tar.gz
          sudo mv trufflehog /usr/local/bin/

      - name: Install jq
        run: sudo apt install jq -y

      # -------------------------
      # Run Scans
      # -------------------------
      - name: Run Gitleaks
        run: gitleaks detect --source . --report-format json --report-path dashboard/gitleaks.json || true

      - name: Run PMD
        run: |
          ./pmd-bin-7.0.0/bin/pmd check \
          --dir force-app \
          --rulesets category/apex/security.xml \
          --format json \
          --report-file dashboard/pmd.json || true

      - name: Run TruffleHog
        run: trufflehog filesystem . --json > dashboard/trufflehog.json || true

      # -------------------------
      # Convert PMD → Sonar format
      # -------------------------
      - name: Convert PMD
        run: bash convert-pmd-to-sonar.sh

      # -------------------------
      # SonarQube Scan
      # -------------------------
      - name: Sonar Scan
        uses: sonarsource/sonarqube-scan-action@v2
        env:
          SONAR_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SONAR_TOKEN }}
          SONAR_HOST_URL: ${{ secrets.SONAR_HOST_URL }}

      - name: Quality Gate
        uses: sonarsource/sonarqube-quality-gate-action@v1
        timeout-minutes: 5
        env:
          SONAR_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SONAR_TOKEN }}

      # -------------------------
      # Update Dashboard JSON
      # -------------------------
      - name: Update Dashboard
        run: bash update-dashboard.sh

      # -------------------------
      # Upload dashboard artifact
      # -------------------------
      - name: Upload Dashboard
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dashboard
          path: |
            dashboard/index.html
            dashboard/dashboard-data.json

  # Deploy Dashboard (GitHub Pages)
  # -------------------------
  deploy:
    needs: scan
